title: heteropappus decipiens var. elisabethinus
intro: Heteropappus decipiens var. elisabethinus, commonly known as  Elisabeth's golden aster, is a plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral agent, helping to soothe wounds and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Elisabeth's golden aster include its antimicrobial and antispasmodic properties, which can help to calm digestive issues and relieve pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
